prompt: Do exactly these steps in order using your tools, then stop: 1) Use the Write tool to create a file notes.txt containing the text hello. 2) Use the Read tool to read notes.txt. 3) Use the Edit tool to change hello to hello world in notes.txt. 4) Use the Bash tool to run: echo capture-test. 5) Use the Task tool (subagent_type general-purpose) with prompt 'reply with the single word OK and do nothing else' and wait for it to finish. 6) After the subagent finishes, reply with the single word DONE and stop.
